# Open source

* [Telebit](https://telebit.cloud/) - Written in JS.
* [tunnel.pyjam.as](https://tunnel.pyjam.as/) - Uses WireGuard directly.
* [SSH-J.com](https://bitbucket.org/ValdikSS/dropbear-sshj/) - Public SSH Jump server.
* [frp](https://github.com/fatedier/frp) - Comprehensive open alternative to ngrok.
* [PageKite](https://pagekite.net/) - Comprehensive open source solution with hosted options.
* [gost](https://latest.gost.run/en/) - TCP and UDP tunneling.
* [zrok](https://zrok.io/) - Aims for effortless sharing.
